square.note: Same scenes. The pull-back peaks at 1.10 instead of 1.30 so the 800px window stays inside the 100px safe area.

colors.background: #FAFAFA — stage, with a static radial lift to #FFFFFF
colors.accent: #4D7C0F — deep lime, legible on white: playhead, silence snap, KEEP, confidence bars, wordmark rule
colors.highlight: #4D7C0F — same single accent; no second highlight color

scenes.purpose: A single accent line draws down on the light stage. It is the playhead, the continuity carrier.
scenes.layout: Empty stage. The line is centered on the timeline's future center, 2px wide.
scenes.elements: Accent line #4D7C0F grows from 0 to 520px over 18 frames starting at frame 8, holds, then contracts to the 128px track height over frames 56–74.
scenes.animation: Draw uses cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). A synthesized tick lands as the line finishes, frame 28.
scenes.lighting: Near-white stage. No particles, no sweep.
scenes.transitionOut: Match cut. Frame 74 is the settled playhead; frame 75 is the same line on the track.

scenes.purpose: The playhead slides right and the timeline prints behind it. Editing is still waiting.
scenes.emotionalBeat: The old pace: the line does the walking.
scenes.voiceover: Editing has always waited for you.
scenes.layout: Headline in the top safe area, two lines, 96px. Track centered in the column that also fits the square cut.
scenes.elements: Headline 'Editing has always' / 'waited for you.' Waveform bars and five clips print as the playhead passes. Clips: confusing, a 0.70s silence, history., um, point.
scenes.animation: Playhead x is linear from 0.5 to 0.8 of the track. Bars and clips enter with opacity, 12px translateY, and blur 8 to 0 over 14–16 frames.
scenes.camera: Scale eases 1.00 to 1.30 so the next shot can pull back without a jump.
scenes.transitionOut: Match cut at scale 1.30, playhead at 0.8, chrome still closed around the track.

scenes.purpose: The track is inside CutPilot. The window opens and the camera settles.
scenes.emotionalBeat: The tool was already around the timeline.
scenes.voiceover: What if the timeline cut itself?
scenes.layout: Same track. A 800×416 window, 1px #00000014 border, 16px radius, soft shadow, title 'CutPilot' and mono 'live'.
scenes.animation: Clip-path inset morphs from the track rect to the full window over 18 frames. Tilt eases 0 to 7 degrees, then flattens to 0 while scale eases 1.30 to 1.00.
scenes.camera: Pull back 1.30 to 1.00. Tilt only in this shot.
scenes.lighting: Soft shadow appears with the window. No glow.
scenes.transitionOut: Match cut at scale 1, tilt 0, window fully open on the timeline.

scenes.purpose: A real silence region and a real filler snap closed. This is the hero cut.
scenes.emotionalBeat: The timeline moves on its own.
scenes.voiceover: CutPilot Live makes every cut in real time.
scenes.layout: Push-in on the timeline. Mono label under the track. No display headline.
scenes.elements: Silence block is interview s005, 700ms, labeled 'cut · silence 0.70 s'. Filler is stand-in s003, 500ms, labeled 'cut · filler "um" 0.50 s'.
scenes.animation: Each region fills to the accent over 14 frames, then its width hits 0 with spring damping 18 stiffness 180. Later clips ripple left and overshoot. Camera scale 1.00 to 1.06.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in. Playhead stays linear and does not bounce.
scenes.lighting: The accent block is flat fill, not a glow.
scenes.transitionOut: Match cut. The window starts a horizontal pan from the timeline to the log.

scenes.purpose: Every decision is a line with a real timestamp, action, and confidence.
scenes.layout: Headline above the window. Inside: three log rows and one measured latency row. Confidence bars fill to the real value.
scenes.elements: t=18.29s CUT silence 0.97; t=3.60s CUT filler "um" 0.95; t=10.90s CUT joke 0.84. Footer 'rule p50 0.02 ms p99 1.40 ms' from the benchmark log. Headline 'Every decision,' / 'logged.'
scenes.animation: Rows stagger 14 frames. Each enters with opacity, translateY 16px, blur 8 to 0 over 16 frames. Bars fill with the same bezier.
scenes.camera: Holds 1.06. The pan is the body of the window, 18 frames.
scenes.transitionOut: Match cut into the steer panel.

scenes.purpose: A mid-run note changes the next joke and leaves the earlier cut alone.
scenes.emotionalBeat: The editor is still in charge.
scenes.voiceover: Steer it mid-flight. Tell it to keep the jokes.
scenes.layout: A single field types 'keep the jokes'. Two mono rows underneath.
scenes.elements: 10.90s joke stays CUT 0.84, dimmed. 26.90s joke switches from CUT 0.84 to KEEP 0.93, the accent. Those are the rule outputs for stand-in s009 and s015. Headline 'Steer it' / 'mid-flight.'
scenes.animation: Typewriter, 2 frames per character, caret on the beat. KEEP color eases over 16 frames. No overshoot.
scenes.camera: Holds 1.06. Pan from log to steer over 18 frames.
scenes.transitionOut: Hard cut on the beat to the wide shot.

scenes.purpose: The sprint pace, shown as the 20 real interview decisions moving at 10 per second.
scenes.layout: Big counter above a widened window. Compact clip row. Log viewport.
scenes.elements: Counter lands on '~10' in Geist so the zero stays a plain zero, with the line 'decisions / second'. Log rows stay Ioskeley Mono. The rows are the rule decisions on the benchmarked interview, including the 0.72 trim. No invented confidences.
scenes.animation: Counter is linear from 0 to 10 over 30 frames, then holds '~10'. Log rows move 16px per frame with a 3px blur, then sharpen. Camera eases 1.06 to 0.96.
scenes.transitionOut: Hard cut to white on the beat.

scenes.purpose: A silent white hold. The first 12 frames are the mandated silence; the rest of the shot stays silent too.
scenes.transitionOut: Hard cut to the end card.

scenes.purpose: The finished timeline collapses into the wordmark.
scenes.emotionalBeat: A name, then where it lives.
scenes.voiceover: CutPilot Live. Continuous decision AI for video.
scenes.layout: Centered lockup inside the 880px column. Wordmark, accent rule, two secondary lines, repo URL.
scenes.elements: Six clip chips collapse into one accent bar. The bar becomes a 4px rule under 'CutPilot Live'. Secondary: 'Continuous decision AI for video.' / 'Inside OpenChatCut.' URL github.com/Duylamneuuu/OpenChatCut. The wordmark is first visible at frame 816 and remains under 3 seconds.
scenes.animation: Chips converge over 20 frames. Wordmark enters with opacity, 16px rise, blur 8 to 0 over 16 frames. The lockup scales 1.00 to 1.02 across the shot.
scenes.lighting: Stage radial returns. The accent is only the rule.
